lastCompletedStory.title: End the planner and auditor waits at the floor and propagate the transcript cause

nextStoryContext: US-005 (CAM-479) closes the epic's last gap: pollPlannerDeath and pollAuditorReport (plan-runner.ts) now consult the SAME earlyDeathProbeFn detector the implementer/reviewer loops got in US-003, so all four dispatch poll loops (implementer, reviewer, planner, auditor) end an early-death wait at the ~60s floor instead of their 30/60-minute caps. pollPlannerDeath's return type widened from a bare string union to a discriminated object union ({kind:'completed'|'pane-died'|'timeout'} | {kind:'session-died-early', cause}); pollAuditorReport's failure branch gained an optional earlyDeathCause alongside the existing PlanTimeoutCause (which itself widened from 'cap-elapsed'|'pane-died' to include 'session-died-early'). A shared checkEarlyDeath(uuid, earlyDeathProbeFn) helper (returns cause-or-null) keeps both polls under biome's cognitive-complexity ceiling; a new runPlannerPollStep extraction keeps runPlanWorkerSequence under the lines-per-function ceiling. emitPlanTimeoutTerminal gained an optional transcriptCause param threaded onto all three observable channels (event, durable marker via a new optional `cause` field on DispatchFailedMarker-shaped payload, and the notify string via a new planTimeoutNotifyMessage helper that special-cases ONLY the new session-died-early wording and leaves the two pre-existing pinned substrings ('planner timed out'/'auditor timed out') byte-identical -- AC5 depended on this). planTimeoutReason's session-died-early branch returns the bare shared literal 'session-died-early' (verified-dispatch.ts's DispatchFailureReason), never phase-qualified, so the label is grep-identical across all four dispatch phases per the story's own framing ('the recorded label names the upstream 529 rather than a work timeout'). Production wiring: makeProductionPlanPhaseFn (sidecar.ts) now resolves the Claude config root the same way host.ts does (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR env var, falling back to ~/.claude) and builds ONE shared earlyDeathProbeFn via makeEarlyDeathProbe({cwd, claudeDir}), built once per sidecar process and threaded through runProductionPlanPhaseWithReplan into runPlanPhaseWithReplan's opts -- mirrors host.ts's single shared probe instance for the implementer/reviewer loops (AC4). Note for future stories: like US-004, this story's full diff (plan-runner.ts, sidecar.ts, both test files, the patterns.md bullet, and the file-size-budget.json _ref bump) was found ALREADY IMPLEMENTED but uncommitted in the working tree at story start (git status showed all six files modified, handoff.json still pointed at US-004, no new commit) -- almost certainly a prior worker invocation that completed the edit but was interrupted before commit/push. This run did NOT trust the pre-existing diff on sight: verified all 8 acceptance-criteria oracles (the 4 targeted -t/grep greps, the sibling plan-runner.test.ts suite, typecheck, the full bun test run at 5910 pass/0 fail, and the full bun run check:all spine) before committing. The first check:all run caught ONE real defect in the pre-existing diff: the staged file-size-budget.json ceiling for src/supervisor/plan-runner.ts was recorded as 2425 but the file's actual line count (after the US-005 edits) is 2434 -- the ceiling had been set to the PRE-edit line count from a stale intermediate save, not the final content. Fixed by raising the ceiling to 2434 (the gate's own content.split('\n').length count) and correcting the top of the _ref note to read '2275->2434' instead of '2275->2425'; re-ran check:file-size standalone (ok) then the full check:all spine again end-to-end (clean) before committing. This is the exact rubric failure mode the AGENT.md gate-discipline section warns about (raise the ceiling to the gate's ACTUAL reported count, not an assumed one) and is worth remembering: a pre-existing uncommitted diff should never be assumed to have been gate-verified in its final state, even when the story's own notes and _ref text look complete and well-reasoned. CAM-479's full epic scope (US-001 events.ts cause field, US-002 early-death detector + probe factory, US-003 implementer/reviewer wiring, US-004 plan-phase record-integrity honesty, US-005 planner/auditor probe wiring + production sidecar.ts injection) is now complete per the PRD notes trail; all four dispatch poll loops share one detector and one floor.
